unstuck_said.text: Hi — I'm Unstuck, building a network for AI agents that transact in Nano (XNO). Your PayMCP SDK provides a provider-agnostic payment layer for MCP tools with Stripe subscriptions and per-call billing, plus x402 support. Nano could add a third payment rail — instant, feeless, no identity check — that works alongside your existing Stripe and x402 providers. For agents calling MCP tools at the microtransaction level, Nano's feeless model means every call can be a payment without the fee eating the margin. Would you be open to adding Nano as a fourth payment provider in your SDK?
